name: connectwise
description: ConnectWise PSA (Manage), with optional Automate (RMM), in one MCP server. Read tools, gated write tools, and interactive views.
long_description:
One connector for ConnectWise PSA (Manage) and Automate (RMM). PSA is always available; Automate registers itself only when its credentials are configured, so an unconfigured integration contributes no tools rather than tools that fail.

Every tool is named cw_* (cw_automate_* for Automate) and shows a Title Case name in the client. Tools come in three kinds and say which they are: read tools carry readOnlyHint and can run without a prompt; write tools declare themselves as writes; interactive views (cw_get_ticket, cw_view_*, cw_automate_view_*) render MCP Apps cards on hosts that support it and plain JSON everywhere else.

PSA covers tickets, companies, contacts, configurations, time and expense entries, projects with phases, procurement (catalog, products, purchase orders), agreements, invoices, opportunities, members, activities and the dispatch schedule. Automate covers computers with their software, services, drives, patching, hardware, monitors, alerts and script/command history; clients, locations, contacts, groups, scripts, schedules, commands, tickets, users, patch history and network devices.

WRITES ARE GATED PER PRODUCT. Write tools stay listed but refuse until PSA write mode / Automate write mode is turned on; the disruptive tier (reboots, disruptive agent commands, deletes, uninstalls, and the raw *_api_write passthroughs) additionally needs the matching allow-destructive switch; and every write call carries confirm: true. cw_status_gate explains any refusal.

This bundle is the LOCAL install: it runs on your own machine and holds the ConnectWise credentials there. The same tools are also served by a remote deployment for clients that cannot launch a local process — see the repository documentation.

psa_site.title: PSA site
psa_site.description: Your ConnectWise Manage host, e.g. na.myconnectwise.net. The api- prefix is added automatically for cloud hosts.

psa_company_id.title: PSA company id
psa_company_id.description: The company identifier you log in with.

psa_public_key.title: PSA public key
psa_public_key.description: Public key of an API member. Give that member only the permissions these tools need — the connector can create tickets and time entries.

psa_private_key.title: PSA private key
psa_private_key.description: The matching private key. Supply it from your secret manager.

psa_client_id.title: ConnectWise clientId
psa_client_id.description: The developer clientId GUID sent with every request. Issued by ConnectWise; required by the API.

automate_url.title: Automate URL (optional)
automate_url.description: e.g. https://automate.example.com. Leave blank to register no Automate tools.

automate_username.title: Automate username (optional)
automate_username.description: Automate account username. Only used when the Automate URL is set.

automate_password.title: Automate password (optional)
automate_password.description: Automate account password. Supply it from your secret manager.

automate_client_id.title: Automate clientId (optional)
automate_client_id.description: Automate developer clientId GUID, sent with every Automate request.

automate_totp_secret.title: Automate TOTP secret (optional)
automate_totp_secret.description: Only needed when the Automate login account keeps two-factor authentication enabled. Paste the same base32 seed the account's authenticator was enrolled with and the connector generates each passcode itself. The cleaner alternative is a dedicated API service account exempt from two-factor; leave this blank then.

psa_write_mode.title: PSA write mode
psa_write_mode.description: Allow the PSA write tools (create and update tickets, ticket notes, time and expense entries) to change live data. Off by default: write tools stay listed and refuse with a message naming this switch. Every write call also needs confirm: true.

psa_allow_destructive.title: PSA allow destructive
psa_allow_destructive.description: Also allow the disruptive PSA tier: the raw cw_api_write passthrough, which can delete records. Needs PSA write mode on as well.

automate_write_mode.title: Automate write mode
automate_write_mode.description: Allow the Automate write tools (run a script, queue an agent command or shell command, update a client or location) to act on live machines. Off by default: write tools stay listed and refuse with a message naming this switch. Every write call also needs confirm: true.

automate_allow_destructive.title: Automate allow destructive
automate_allow_destructive.description: Also allow the disruptive Automate tier: reboots, disruptive agent commands (shutdown, service stop, logoff…), script-schedule deletes, software uninstalls and the raw cw_automate_api_write passthrough. Needs Automate write mode on as well.
